scene1_screen1.text: Midnight. The kind of hour when bad decisions put on cloaks and pretend to be destiny.

scene1_screen2.text: Jade stumbles through the underbrush with a tote bag full of questionable spiritual supplies and two glasses of boxed red wine sloshing in her stomach.

scene1_screen3.text: (mutters) Witches in movies always make this look so elegant. I look like a raccoon trying to cosplay Stevie Nicks.

scene1_screen4.text: She drops to her knees in a small clearing, breath fogging the air. Crumpled instructions from Nikki flutter in her hands — a handwritten spell and three passive-aggressive hearts.

scene1_screen5.text: (reading) “Call on the veil, speak from the soul, and light three candles.” (Scoffs.) Easy. I’ve lit worse things drunk.

scene1_screen6.text: The candles flare. The salt circle is... sort of a circle. Her voice shakes — from cold, or nerves, or the surreal knowledge that she is, in fact, spellcasting at midnight like someone who owns too many crystals.

scene1_screen7.text: O spirits, or… whatever — I wish for change. I wish for... someone. Anyone. Someone who sees me. Who stays. (beat) … and maybe who looks good shirtless, I dunno, I’m multitasking here.

scene1_screen8.text: Silence. For a beat, Jade relaxes — embarrassed, tipsy, and relieved it didn’t work. She reaches for the wine.

scene1_screen9.text: Then — the candles blow out. The shadows stretch inward. The clearing darkens like a camera shutter closing, and the air itself folds.

scene1_screen10.text: Something arrives. He steps forward like he’s been sculpted from the night itself — tall, sharp-jawed, with eyes that seem to remember things the stars have forgotten. Not glowing. But glowing adjacent.

scene1_screen11.text: Jade freezes. Her breath catches. And then — she screams. Loud. Unapologetically human. Hands flail, and a candle goes flying.

scene1_screen12.text: (panicking) Oh my GOD, WHO ARE YOU?! Do NOT murder me, I have pepper spray and... okay it’s just scented mist, but it burns eyes, okay!?

scene1_screen14.text: She backs into a tree, grabbing a stick like it’s Excalibur. Her whole body shakes, wine buzz vanishing like her dignity.

scene1_screen15.text: What are you?! No — why are you?!

scene1_screen16.text: The man tilts his head, almost curiously. His voice, when it comes again, is like velvet with thorns.

scene1_screen17.text: I am what your soul reached for. The echo your desire woke.

scene1_screen22.text: You may call me Nоlan. Most do.

scene1_screen23.text: (wheezing) Oh cool, yeah, no big deal, just casually summoning someone named Desirability. McShadowhair. I knew I shouldn’t have done spells while buzzed.

scene1_screen24.text: He watches her with mild amusement. Or maybe deep eldritch indifference. Hard to tell.

scene1_screen25.text: Your wish bound me. Until it is fulfilled, I walk beside you.

scene1_screen26.text: Okay, so you’re like... a magical boyfriend I can’t return?

scene1_choice1.text: How do you respond to Nolan’s sudden claim of belonging?

opts.text: Flirt your way through the horror spiral

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Jade slowly lowers her tree branch and squares her shoulders.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (dryly) Well, Nolan, since you’re mine now — do you cook? Clean? Magically refill wine bottles?

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: He arches a brow. Slight amusement curls the corner of his mouth.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen4.text: I’ve never been asked that on arrival.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (grinning) Stick with me, sunshine. I’m a trendsetter. (beat) So, what are the odds of you having a six-pack under that broody cloak? Strictly research.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen6.text: He steps closer, and for a brief second, the air between them tightens — humming with something hot and unfamiliar.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen7.text: (softly) You speak through fear...But you’re not wrong. About the six-pack.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen8.text: Jade laughs — a breathless, nervous thing — and lets her back slide against the tree.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen9.text: Okay. Stay. But if you turn into a goat at dawn, I’m out.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Jade bolts upright, grabs her bag, and whirls around — only to realize the trees have... moved?

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Or maybe the paths have disappeared. Or the forest itself is playing tricks. Either way — she’s not going anywhere.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Nope. Nope. This isn’t happening. You’re a very vivid wine ghost. (under breath) Nikki is so blocked.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (gently) I told you. There is no escape from the wish once it’s spoken.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen5.text: A crow calls in the distance — once, sharp — like punctuation.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Jade steadies herself, breath ragged. Her voice is high, but clear.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: No jokes. Who are you really? What do you want? And why the hell me?

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: He studies her. Quiet. Then he speaks.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Not many remember how to ask that. (beat) Your wish called because your heart broke in a way that echoed beyond this world. That’s all it takes.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: His gaze burns with something she doesn’t want to name.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: And what I want... is to see how your story ends.

scene1_screen28.text: Somewhere, the stars rearrange themselves. A pact has begun. And whether Jade believes in magic or not, magic now believes in her.

scene2_screen1.text: It’s been eight hours since he crossed over. And already, Nolan knows: this world is loud, fast, and absolutely ridiculous.

scene2_screen2.text: He stands near the window, watching traffic crawl through the early morning haze. Somewhere in the apartment, Jade loses a battle with a slipper.

scene2_screen3.text: (offscreen) Why is this cat acting like I’m a ghost possessing her real owner?

scene2_screen4.text: She likely senses that you summoned something older than time itself.

scene2_screen5.text: (entering) If you say “older” one more time while looking like a moody Calvin Klein model, I swear I’ll scream.

scene2_screen6.text: Hair in a bun, eyes tired but sharp. There’s no chaos in her — just someone who stopped pretending she could keep up.

scene2_screen7.text: You still haven’t told me what exactly you wished for.

scene2_screen8.text: (sighs) Yeah. Because it sounds ridiculous. Even to me. And I was there.

scene2_screen9.text: He waits. Quietly. And she groans, rubbing her temples.

scene2_screen10.text: Fine. I said — and I quote — “I wish someone would just take over my life. Like, handle everything. Be the grown-up. Make decisions, pay bills, smile at the landlord. While I lie in bed, eat noodles, and stare at the ceiling indefinitely.”

scene2_screen11.text: Maybe there was something about having strong hands and a calm voice. I blacked out a little.

scene2_screen12.text: Nolan stares. Not with judgment. With something like confusion. Awe. Or maybe horror.

scene2_screen13.text: You summoned a cosmic force of desire… because you’re tired of being responsible?

scene2_screen14.text: (deadpan) Yup. Welcome to your new mission: saving a burned-out millennial with commitment issues and a sleep debt older than your soul.

scene2_screen15.text: He takes it in. The absurdity. The honesty. The wish isn't grand or noble. But somehow, it pulses with power. Maybe because it’s real.

scene2_choice1.text: How do you respond to the truth behind her wish?

opts.text: Take her seriously… but tease her anyway
Accept the role — just as she asked
Judge her — and regret it immediately

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: He crosses his arms, eyes gleaming with faint amusement.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: So, you summoned the Desire Incarnate… to be your life admin?

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Better than summoning another useless boyfriend named Tyler.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (dry) I once watched a prince crumble an empire under the weight of unpaid invoices. (beat) He also wanted to nap indefinitely.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: He walks over to her desk. It’s covered in sticky notes, old planners, unopened resumes. A half-finished to-do list reads: “Meal prep. Taxes. Cry.”

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: He looks at her. Eyes deep and unwavering.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: But you won’t disappear. You’ll watch. Learn. You didn’t summon relief. You summoned a partnership.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Jade says nothing. But something in her stillness shifts — just slightly.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: You didn’t want help. You wanted to surrender.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (flat) Wow. Harsh. Thanks for the shame spiral, Magic Man.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: She turns away, folding her arms tight across her chest.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Door’s right there. Next to the sign that says “Chaos lives here.”

scene2_choice1_option3_screen6.text: He hesitates. Just for a moment. But enough to feel something twist in his chest.

scene2_screen16.text: Outside, clouds shift unnaturally. Something far from kind stirs. The wish has been made. And somewhere in the dark folds of this world… something is watching.

scene3_screen1.text: The office lobby is sleek, efficient, and very much Not Meant for Mystical Entities.

scene3_screen2.text: By contrast, Jade looks like a glitch in the matrix in her oversized blazer, chunky boots, a laptop bag patched with pins and defiance.

scene3_screen3.text: She’s a designer. Not just by title — by nature. Color, feeling, and friction are her language. But here, they speak in metrics.

scene3_screen4.text: Jade walks fast, eyes forward, hoping the security guard doesn’t stop her for bringing an extremely tall man who looks like he stepped out of a cursed Renaissance painting.

scene3_screen5.text: (whispering) You can’t just stroll in. There's a badge system.

scene3_screen7.text: He places one hand lightly on the scanner. It beeps. Turns green.

scene3_screen8.text: No ID. No logic. Just… acceptance.

scene3_screen10.text: (dry) It’s cooperative if you ask nicely.

scene3_screen11.text: They enter. No one stops him. No one even sees him — not really. To most eyes, he's just another consultant. Another suit.

scene3_screen12.text: Jade takes her seat. Opens her laptop. Everything is already prepared. The files sorted. Slides refined. Her notes — her usually incoherent, last-minute ramblings — are perfectly outlined.

scene3_screen13.text: (murmuring) You used magic on my desktop?

scene3_screen14.text: I used logic. And a bit of longing.

scene3_screen15.text: 10:00 AM. The meeting room fills with colleagues, client, decision-makers. Coffee cups in hand. Anxiety disguised as confidence.

scene3_screen16.text: Jade steps up to present. She’s ready. She shouldn’t be — but she is. Thanks to him.

opts.text: Project full confidence and own the moment

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Jade steps forward. No theatrics. Just purpose. Her voice cuts through the buzz like clarity through fog.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: We designed this not to impress — but to make things easier. For real people. On real deadlines.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: No stumbles. No filler. She walks them through the pain points, the logic, the soul behind the structure.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: This isn’t about reinventing the wheel. It’s about getting out of the user’s way. Clean flow. Fewer drop-offs. No friction.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen5.text: By the third slide, the client is nodding. Her manager glances sideways like he’s seeing her for the first time. Someone near the back whispers, “Where has this version of her been?”

scene3_choice1_option1_screen6.text: When she finishes, the room exhales — not relieved, but impressed. And Jade doesn’t blush. Doesn’t retreat.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen8.text: She just nods once and takes her seat — like someone who finally knows she belongs at the front of the room.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Jade clears her throat and taps the mic — it squeaks just enough to make her wince.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (half-laughing) Well, that’s accurate. Hi. I’m Jade, and this pitch was brought to you by three iced coffees and a quarter-life crisis.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Laughter. Not loud, but real. Heads turn. Phones lower.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: But seriously — I designed this after waking up too many mornings thinking, “Why is everything harder than it should be?” That’s what we tried to fix.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen5.text: She gestures to the screen, walking them through the slides like it’s a story. Her voice isn’t polished — it’s personal.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen6.text: We didn’t want “pretty.” We wanted intuitive. We wanted kindness built into the clicks.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Someone near the window nods slowly. The client leans forward, elbows on the table. A colleague grins.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen8.text: (quietly, to another) Didn’t know she had this in her.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen9.text: By the end, the room stays quiet for a breath — thoughtful, engaged. Then a few people smile. Someone says, “Let’s talk next steps.”

scene3_choice1_option2_screen10.text: Jade exhales. Not because it’s over — but because, for once, she didn’t have to fake her voice to be heard.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: She opens her mouth — but nothing comes out. The slides blur. The room stretches. Her heartbeat thunders in her ears. A cold rush of panic climbs up her spine — like falling in a dream and not waking up in time.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: She glances at Nolan. He meets her eyes — steady, unblinking.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (softly, just for her) Speak. I’m here.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: And suddenly, everything stills — like stepping into warm, still water.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (calmly) We approached this with one question: how do we make clarity feel effortless?

scene3_choice1_option3_screen7.text: She moves through the presentation like she’s done it a hundred times. Polished. Smooth. Distant.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen8.text: Our redesign eliminates friction points across key flows. We’re not just optimizing — we’re respecting attention.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen9.text: The client nods. Someone even murmurs “impressive.” It’s perfect. Too perfect.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen10.text: She returns to her seat, face still composed.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen11.text: (quietly, without looking at him) That wasn’t me.

scene3_screen17.text: The meeting wraps. People file out, chatting in pairs, sipping what's left of their coffee. The room softens back into buzz and motion.

scene3_screen18.text: Jade lingers near the screen, hands still clasped. No one’s looking anymore. The moment is over — or maybe it never quite belonged to her.

scene3_screen19.text: Nolan appears beside her. Quiet, watching, impossible to ignore.

scene3_screen20.text: That was your wish, wasn’t it? Success. Control. Relief.

scene3_screen22.text: He studies her. Not smug. Not triumphant. Just... curious.

scene3_screen24.text: That stops her. She turns, confused.

scene3_screen26.text: If that had truly been your desire — your real one — I would’ve disappeared. That’s the rule.

scene3_screen27.text: A pause. The fluorescent lights above him. Her throat tightens.

scene3_screen28.text: (gently) But I’m still here. Which means… that wasn’t it.

scene3_screen29.text: Her heart pounds. Chest tight. Suddenly, everything feels too real. Too exposed.

scene3_screen30.text: (defensive) Don’t. Just — don’t psychoanalyze me with your ancient eyes and mystical cheekbones.

scene3_screen31.text: You don’t have to admit it now. But you will. Eventually.

scene3_screen32.text: (sharply) You think you know me? You’re a spell. An error. A glitch in my exhausted nervous breakdown.

scene3_screen33.text: She grabs her coat. Stumbles past him, avoiding his gaze.

scene3_screen34.text: (quietly) Maybe you’re not still here because of me. Maybe you're here because you’re stuck too.

scene3_screen35.text: She doesn’t wait for a reply. She walks away fast, as if it’s the only defense she has left.

scene3_screen36.text: Nolan stands alone by the glass wall. His reflection layered over the city skyline.

scene3_screen37.text: He touches his chest, almost absently. Still here. Still tethered. And … not entirely sure he wants to leave.

scene4_screen1.text: They’ve been sitting together for almost an hour. Not talking. Not needing to. The movie plays. Neither is really watching. The wine sits unfinished on the table, forgotten.

scene4_screen2.text: Jade’s knees are drawn up, blanket over her legs. She glances at Nolan now and then — and every time, he’s already looking at her.

scene4_screen3.text: (softly) You didn’t disappear after the wish, as it wasn’t real, you say…So what is it, then? What do you think I actually want?

scene4_screen4.text: He turns his head, slowly, like the truth deserves gravity.

scene4_screen5.text: Something different. Something deeper than just success. Or control. Or even rest.

scene4_screen6.text: You want your life to mean something. To feel like it’s yours — not a version of yourself you built out of fear.

scene4_screen7.text: That lands harder than she expects. She looks away.

scene4_screen10.text: He’s quiet for a long time. Then, with an odd calmness, he speaks.

scene4_screen11.text: I’ve never told anyone this. Not even those who summoned me before.

scene4_screen12.text: She turns to him, sensing the weight in his voice.

scene4_screen13.text: I wasn’t always what I am now.

scene4_screen16.text: Once. A long time ago. I was human. Ordinary, in most ways.

scene4_screen17.text: He doesn’t blink as he says it, as if looking backward costs something.

scene4_screen18.text: I lived quietly. Safely. I did what was expected. And in doing so, I let every part of myself dim. Until there was nothing left but longing.

scene4_screen20.text: And then I died. And didn’t go. That longing — it became me. Now, I answer other people’s. Because I didn’t answer my own.

scene4_screen21.text: She doesn’t know what to say. Her throat is tight. It’s not pity she feels — it’s recognition.

scene4_screen22.text: They sit with that silence, until it softens into something else. A real connection. She reaches for his hand. No magic. No flicker of light. Just warmth.

scene4_screen25.text: Their faces are close now. Not deliberately. Just… drawn. He watches her — not as a summoned creature. Not even as a man. As someone choosing her in this moment.

scene4_choice1.text: What do you do with the closeness between you?

opts.text: Stay close, without crossing the line

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: She leans forward, her fingers brushing against the base of his throat.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (whispers) I don’t know what this is. But I know I want it.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen3.text: He answers her — not with words, but with a kiss. Slow. Grounded. Devastatingly sincere. The kind of kiss that rewrites silence.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Time bends around them. The world outside fades — the rain, the job, the scaffolding of everything expected.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen5.text: They draw closer, hands seeking familiarity in the unfamiliar. Her breath catches once. His eyes soften — like seeing something lost finally return.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen6.text: There’s no urgency. Only warmth. Trust. And the quiet thrill of choosing each other fully, with nothing left held back.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: She cups his face in both hands and leans in. The kiss is gentle — not hesitant, but sacred. Like a truth spoken in a language only the two of them know.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: His hands come to her waist, anchoring her like she might vanish. They breathe together, still touching even after their lips part.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen3.text: The moment isn’t loud, but it’s loud inside. Something shifts in both of them — the smallest breaking open.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: She leans into his side and rests her head against his shoulder. He wraps his arm around her, and she melts into the warmth like it’s a shelter.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: They sit that way for a long time. No expectations. No urgency. Just shared stillness. Sometimes love starts with silence. With breathing next to someone who doesn't ask you to perform strength.

scene4_screen26.text: Jade exhales, voice low and raw.

scene4_screen27.text: (quietly) You were right. I didn’t want rest. Or control. I wanted the courage to choose something else.

scene4_screen28.text: He says nothing — not yet. Just listens. She turns to him, finally meeting his eyes fully.

scene4_screen29.text: I’m scared of changing everything. But I’m more scared of staying where I don’t belong.

scene4_screen30.text: Nolan reaches for her hand — no magic, just presence. Steady, warm.

scene4_screen31.text: Then don’t stay. Risk it. You already did something harder — you faced yourself.

scene4_screen32.text: She stands slowly, crosses the room, and picks up her laptop — like lifting a weight she’s finally ready to carry. Nolan follows, wordless.

scene4_screen33.text: They sit side by side at her laptop. The screen glows again, cursor blinking in that same draft email — subject line: “Notice of Resignation.”

scene4_screen34.text: She hesitates, fingers hovering over the keyboard.

scene4_screen35.text: (half-laughing) You’re gonna be really smug if I do this, aren’t you?

scene4_screen37.text: She smiles. And begins typing. He watches — not directing, not fixing. Just present. And when she finishes, she looks up at him. He nods.

scene4_screen39.text: Most people wish for escape. You wished for truth. That’s the kind of magic that rewrites endings.

scene4_screen40.text: The TV flickers quietly as the credits of the movie roll. Neither of them moves to turn it off.

scene4_screen41.text: Jade curls up against him, the weight of the day — and the decision — finally softening.

scene4_screen42.text: Her head settles on his lap. One arm draped over his knee, as if to anchor herself in the moment she just chose.

scene4_screen43.text: Nolan gently threads his fingers through her hair, as if memorizing the shape of what trust looks like.

scene4_screen44.text: She drifts off slowly, the tension fading from her shoulders, her breath evening out. Eyes closed. Safe.

scene4_screen45.text: He looks down at her with something between wonder and quiet awe.

scene4_screen46.text: (thinking) I think I became more real… the moment I stopped answering someone else’s longing and finally listened to my own.

scene4_screen47.text: For the first time in a long, long time… He doesn’t feel like a wish. He feels wanted.

scene5_screen1.text: Jade wakes to silence. No emails waiting to be answered. No alarms yelling about meetings. No weight of pretending to care.

scene5_screen2.text: (thinking) Last night didn’t feel like magic. It felt like permission. To be soft. To be scared. To be real.

scene5_screen3.text: The couch is empty. The room still carries a trace of warmth where someone sat. Where someone held her.

scene5_screen4.text: She stretches, slowly, like someone not used to breathing deeply. Her fingers find the edge of the blanket and pull it closer, as if it still holds him.

scene5_screen5.text: He’s gone. But it doesn’t feel like loss. It feels like a pause. Like a comma.

scene5_screen6.text: She thinks of his eyes. Of the way he said nothing when she needed space, and everything when she needed truth. She wonders — if he could feel human again… would he want to stay?

scene5_screen8.text: One new email: “Resignation received and processed. Wishing you clarity, creativity, and luck.”

scene5_screen9.text: She stares at it, heart skipping once — not in panic. In quiet awe.

scene5_screen10.text: (smiling, to herself) I really did it.

scene5_screen11.text: She slips into jeans, shrugs on her jacket, and ties her hair up without thinking too hard. No roles today. No armor.

scene5_screen12.text: Just coffee. And maybe a little hope.

scene5_screen13.text: The café is warm, already half-full. She steps in line, humming under her breath. Feels... light. For the first time in years.

scene5_screen14.text: And then someone steps in front of her. Familiar height. Familiar shoulders. He turns.

scene5_screen16.text: He’s smiling. Wearing a dark coat, hair a little messy. Human. Real. Undeniably him.

scene5_screen17.text: Hi. Still like your coffee too hot?

scene5_screen18.text: She laughs — breathless, joyful — and before she even realizes it, she’s closing the distance in two quick steps and throwing her arms around him.

scene5_screen20.text: I am. Not only did I help you, but you also helped me become a man!

scene5_screen21.text: The magic continued between them, and there was no longer any surprise in it. They order. Sit by the window. Just two cups between them — and a thousand unsaid things resting gently in the space between.

scene5_choice1.text: What do you want from this new life?

opts.text: Say goodbye, with gratitude and peace

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: He looks at her — really looks — like he’s anchoring himself in the lines of her face.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen2.text: I don’t want to drift anymore. I don’t want to wait to be needed.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: She watches him, holding her cup close, breath caught.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (softly) You made me feel like more than a force. More than a reaction. You reminded me what it means to choose. So I’m choosing now.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen5.text: He reaches across the table, takes her hand, warm and sure.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Let’s do together all the things we were too scared to even want out loud. Bad coffee. Late trains. Loving each other like there’s no map for it.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen7.text: Jade blinks, overwhelmed — not by doubt, but recognition. This is what she wished for before she knew how to name it.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen8.text: (smiling) Okay. Let’s do it, let’s be brave. Together.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen9.text: He leans forward, and she meets him halfway. The kiss is deep, slow — no fireworks. Just a steady flame that says: we’re here, and we’re not afraid anymore.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: He toys with the edge of his coffee cup, then looks up at her, more boyish than mythical.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (quiet) Would you… want to go on a date sometime?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (grinning) Like a normal one? With awkward menus and someone forgetting their wallet?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (half-laughing) Exactly that. I want awkward with you.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen5.text: She smiles, and this time, she leans across the table and kisses him. A quick press of lips. Soft. Sincere.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen6.text: She pulls back and taps his hand gently.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen7.text: You’re already doing great at the “human” part.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen1.text: He sips his coffee, then sets it down. Looks at her with the kind of expression that holds no regret.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen2.text: You gave me more than a reason to stay. You gave me a way to begin again.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen3.text: She swallows, but her eyes don’t tear up. There’s strength in goodbye, too.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Thank you for everything. Even the weird candle stuff.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen5.text: He laughs. They stand. No lingering, no longing. Just two people letting go the right way.

scene5_screen22.text: Sometimes magic changes your world. Sometimes, it just reminds you are always capable of doing everything yourself.
